subject: Physics
title: Ray Optics and Optical Instruments
summary: Ray optics mein light seedhi rekha (ray) mein chalti hai. Reflection mein angle of incidence = angle of reflection; refraction mein Snell's law n₁ sin i = n₂ sin r. Ghane (zyada n) medium mein light dheemi aur normal ki taraf mudti hai.

Mirror aur lens ke saare sawal ek sign convention (Cartesian: optical centre/pole origin, light ki direction +ve) aur do formulas se hal hote hain: mirror 1/v + 1/u = 1/f, lens 1/v − 1/u = 1/f. Magnification se image ka size aur real/virtual pata chalta hai.

Ghane se halke medium mein critical angle se zyada par light poori wapas laut aati hai — total internal reflection (optical fibre, heera ki chamak, mirage). Prism light ko modta (deviation) hai aur white light ko colours mein todta hai (dispersion).

Lens ki power P = 1/f (dioptre, f metre mein); paas rakhe lenses ki power seedhi judti hai. Microscope chhoti paas ki cheez ko bada dikhata hai, telescope door ki cheez ka angle badhaata hai — dono do lenses (objective + eyepiece) se.

formulas.name: Mirror formula and magnification
formulas.note: Sign convention: u hamesha negative (object saamne). Concave f negative, convex f positive.

formulas.name: Snell's law and refractive index
formulas.formula: n₁ sin i = n₂ sin r;   n = c/v;   ₁n₂ = n₂/n₁ = v₁/v₂ = λ₁/λ₂
formulas.mistake: Frequency medium badalne par NAHI badalti — speed aur wavelength badalte hain.

formulas.name: Apparent depth (normal view)
formulas.formula: apparent depth = real depth / n;   shift = t(1 − 1/n)
formulas.when: Paani ke andar cheez upar dikhti hai.
formulas.note: Upar se (halke medium se) dekhne par divide; andar se bahar dekhne par multiply.

formulas.name: Critical angle and TIR
formulas.formula: sin C = 1/n  (n = denser/rarer);   TIR jab light dense → rare aur i > C
formulas.mistake: TIR sirf ghane se halke medium jaate waqt hota hai — ulta kabhi nahi.

formulas.name: Refraction at a spherical surface
formulas.note: R ka sign: centre light ke aage (refracted side) ho to +ve.

formulas.name: Thin lens formula and magnification
formulas.mistake: Lens ka minus sign mirror se alag hai — mirror formula yahan mat lagao.

formulas.name: Lens maker's formula
formulas.when: Lens ka f banaavat se; medium badalne par.
formulas.note: Lens ko apne se ghane medium mein daalo to convex lens diverging ban jaata hai.

formulas.name: Power of a lens and combination
formulas.formula: P = 1/f (f metre mein, unit dioptre D);   contact mein P = P₁ + P₂, 1/F = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂;   distance d par 1/F = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂ − d/(f₁f₂)
formulas.note: f cm mein ho to P = 100/f.

formulas.name: Prism (angle A)
formulas.formula: r₁ + r₂ = A;   δ = i + e − A;   minimum deviation: i = e, r = A/2, n = sin[(A + δ_m)/2] / sin(A/2)
formulas.note: Min deviation par ray prism ke andar base ke parallel hoti hai — r = A/2 yaad rakho.

formulas.name: Thin prism
formulas.mistake: Bade angle wale prism par yeh formula mat lagao.

formulas.name: Dispersion
formulas.formula: Angular dispersion = (n_v − n_r)A;   dispersive power ω = (n_v − n_r)/(n − 1)
formulas.note: Violet sabse zyada mudta hai, red sabse kam — kyunki n_violet > n_red.

formulas.name: Simple microscope (magnifying glass)
formulas.formula: Image near point par: m = 1 + D/f;   infinity par: m = D/f   (D = 25 cm)

formulas.name: Compound microscope
formulas.formula: m = m_o × m_e;   infinity par (normal adjustment): m ≈ (L/f_o)(D/f_e);   near point par: (L/f_o)(1 + D/f_e)
formulas.note: Objective aur eyepiece DONO ka f chhota hona chahiye.

formulas.name: Astronomical telescope
formulas.formula: Normal adjustment: m = f_o/f_e, length = f_o + f_e;   near point par: m = (f_o/f_e)(1 + f_e/D)
formulas.note: Objective ka f BADA (zyada light, zyada m), eyepiece ka chhota.

formulas.name: Mirror/lens image rules
formulas.formula: Convex mirror aur concave lens: hamesha virtual, seedhi, chhoti image.  Real image hamesha ulti (m negative)
formulas.mistake: Virtual image screen par nahi aati — aankh se dikhti hai.

examples.title: Concave mirror
examples.problem: f = 15 cm ka concave mirror, object 20 cm door. Image kahan aur kaisi?
examples.solution: 1/v = 1/f − 1/u = −1/15 + 1/20 = −1/60 ⇒ v = −60 cm (mirror ke saamne, real). m = −v/u = −3 ⇒ 3 guna badi, ulti.

examples.title: Convex lens
examples.problem: f = 20 cm convex lens, object 30 cm door. Image?
examples.solution: 1/v = 1/f + 1/u = 1/20 − 1/30 = 1/60 ⇒ v = +60 cm (doosri taraf, real). m = v/u = −2 (2 guna, ulti).

examples.title: Lens maker: hawa aur paani
examples.problem: Biconvex lens, |R₁| = |R₂| = 20 cm, n = 1.5. Hawa mein f? Paani (n = 4/3) mein f?

examples.title: Critical angle
examples.problem: Glass (n = 1.5) ka hawa ke saath critical angle?
examples.solution: sin C = 1/1.5 ⇒ C ≈ 41.8°. Isse bade angle par light glass ke andar hi laut aayegi.

examples.title: Tank ki gehraai
examples.problem: 2 m gehra paani (n = 4/3) upar se dekhne par kitna gehra dikhega?
examples.solution: Apparent depth = 2/(4/3) = 1.5 m. Talaa 0.5 m upar utha dikhta hai.

examples.title: Prism se n
examples.problem: Equilateral prism (A = 60°) ka minimum deviation 30°. n?

examples.title: Lenses ka combination
examples.problem: f₁ = +20 cm aur f₂ = −40 cm contact mein. Total power aur f?

examples.title: Compound microscope
examples.problem: f_o = 1 cm, f_e = 5 cm, tube length L = 20 cm, normal adjustment (D = 25 cm). Magnifying power?

examples.title: Telescope
examples.problem: f_o = 100 cm, f_e = 5 cm, normal adjustment. Magnifying power aur tube length?
examples.solution: m = f_o/f_e = 20. Length = f_o + f_e = 105 cm.

examples.title: Curved surface par refraction
examples.problem: Hawa mein point object glass (n = 1.5) ki convex surface (R = 10 cm) se 30 cm door hai. Image kahan?
examples.solution: n₂/v − n₁/u = (n₂ − n₁)/R ⇒ 1.5/v + 1/30 = 0.5/10 ⇒ 1.5/v = 1/60 ⇒ v = 90 cm (glass ke andar, real).

examples.title: Thin prism
examples.problem: A = 4°, n = 1.5 ka patla prism kitna deviation dega?

topics.title: Reflection by spherical mirrors
topics.explain: Concave mirror (converging) — real/virtual dono images; object F ke andar ho to virtual, seedhi, badi (shaving mirror). Convex mirror (diverging) — hamesha chhoti virtual image, wide view (gaadi ka side mirror). Parallel rays focus F se guzarti hain; f = R/2.

topics.title: Refraction at plane surface
topics.explain: Light ghane medium mein normal ki taraf mudti hai. Paani mein pencil tuti dikhti hai, swimming pool kam gehra dikhta hai, taare timtimaate hain (atmosphere ka badalta n).

topics.title: Total internal reflection ke applications
topics.explain: Optical fibre (light core ke andar baar-baar TIR se chalti hai — internet, endoscopy), heera ki chamak (C ≈ 24°), mirage (garam sadak par hawa ki layers), totally reflecting prism (periscope, binocular).

topics.title: Lenses: image formation
topics.explain: Convex lens: object 2F se door — chhoti real; 2F par — same size; F aur 2F ke beech — badi real; F ke andar — virtual seedhi badi (magnifier). Concave lens hamesha chhoti virtual image.

topics.title: Refraction through a prism
topics.explain: Deviation i ke saath pehle ghatta hai, min (δ_m) par i = e, phir badhta hai. Min deviation se n naapte hain. Rainbow aur prism ka spectrum dispersion se — VIBGYOR, violet sabse zyada mudta hai.

topics.title: Optical instruments
topics.explain: Simple microscope ek convex lens. Compound microscope: chhota f_o objective real badi image banata hai, eyepiece use aur bada karta hai. Refracting telescope: bada f_o objective. Reflecting telescope (concave mirror objective, Newtonian/Cassegrain): chromatic aberration nahi, bada aperture sasta, image zyada bright.

topics.title: Human eye ki baat (connected)
topics.explain: Near point D = 25 cm, far point anant. Myopia (paas ka dikhe): concave lens. Hypermetropia (door ka dikhe): convex lens. Presbyopia: bifocal. Astigmatism: cylindrical lens.

ratta: sin C = 1/n;  glass C ≈ 42°, paani ≈ 49°, heera ≈ 24°.
n = sin[(A + δ_m)/2]/sin(A/2);  thin prism δ = (n − 1)A.
Microscope m ≈ (L/f_o)(D/f_e);  telescope m = f_o/f_e, L = f_o + f_e.
Frequency nahi badalti; v aur λ badalte hain.
